# Third party stuff used!

[AngelScript](AngelScript.md) The main language to code games for CE

[JetBrains Mono Font](Jetbrains_mono.md): Used for the default/fallback font

[SDL3](SDL3.md): Used for a lot of the cross platform stuff and the main renderer (sdl_gpu)

[SDL3_ttf](SDL_ttf.md): Used for font loading and renderering

[SDL_image](SDL_image.md): Used for image loading

[ImGui](ImGui.md): Used for the debug ui

[Assimp](Assimp.md) Used for the 3D model importer

[XXHash](XXHash.md) Used for generating the mangled symbol names in the angelscript compiler frontend. (Will probably use for plugin id's too)

[GLM](GLM.md) Used for most renderer stuff (a lot when it comes to 3D)
